question: What is the compound interest on ₹80,000 for 1 year at 10 percent per annum, compounded half-yearly?
solution:
Given:

Principal = ₹80,000

Rate of interest = 10% p.a.

Time = 1 year

Formula used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Now, the compound interest on ₹80,000 for 1 year at 10% p.a. compounded half yearly

Since the interest is compounded half-yearly, so rate will be half and time will be double.

Rate = 10/2 = 5%

Time = 6 × 2 = 12 months or 1 year.

Using the formula:

⇒ 80000(1 + 5/100)² - 80000

⇒ 88200 - 80000

⇒ ₹8,200

**∴ The compound interest on ₹80,000 for 1 year at 10% p.a. compounded half yearly is ₹8,200.**
